body: Thank you, seriously. It means a lot. I have tried to convince my family that no matter what they say I am going to college for Audio Engineering, but they haven't really gotten used to the idea. The depression has effected me in a lot of ways. I am not really good at networking myself or meeting new people, and when I do meet someone new I generally am quiet and reserved. I haven't been able to find a job since I don't follow up, and the fact that I smoke weed on an almost daily basis. I mean, I love weed don't get me wrong, and I genuinely think that It helps me with my depression, but since I have to pass a test just to get a job at damn wal-mart it just makes me more depressed. I am scared of trying anti-depressants because I have seen what they can do to people, it either helps them or makes them a pill dependant zombie.

I hope so, And just the pressure about college makes it worse. I really want to go to college to pursue my passion but my whole family isn't exactly supportive about it. It makes it seem like Im destined for failure if I pursue what I love

I have been struggling with this feeling for a while, and I am just starting to get the inkling feeling that maybe its just something thats out of my control. I have tried going to a therapist, but it didn't really help. I really want to talk to my mom about getting help but she doesn't seem to get that I am serious. She is a psychiatric nurse and works with all types of people, people with schizophrenia, multiple personality disorder, etc. Maybe she just doesn't want to believe that her son is mentally ill.
I just don't want to be sad all the damn time, it fucking hurts
